checksums.name: per-slot CRC-16/GENIBUS-like (poly 0x1021, init 0xFFFF, final complement)
checksums.formula_detail: MSB-first table CRC: crc=0xFFFF; for b in payload: crc=((crc<<8)^table1021[((crc>>8)^b)&0xFF])&0xFFFF; stored=(~crc)&0xFFFF as u16_le at slot+0; covered payload slot+2..slot+size-1 (size-2 bytes). FUN_0800458c returns ~uVar1, loop (uVar1<<8 ^ table[(uVar1>>8 ^ *p)*2]). Init 0xFFFF inferred: only init/xor combo matching all 18 valid slot instances (other inits match only spuriously at wrong lengths).

io_driver_functions.notes: Save writer: param=slot 0-9 via unrecovered jumptable (<10) setting RAM src (unaff_r5); generic path offset=sum u16 sizes table, dest 0x0E000000+offset, FUN_0805481c write, FUN_0805488c verify, retry<5, returns 0 ok/1 fail via jumptable. Gate: byte at DAT+DAT &4 aborts.

Save reader/verifier: FUN_080547b8 read from 0x0E000000+offset (cum. sizes at 0x08002714) to RAM (unaff_r8), *buf vs FUN_0800458c(size-2,buf+1 short* i.e. +2 bytes), retry<3, slot6 extra 30-byte 0..29 check; returns 0 ok/1 fail.
CRC16 MSB-first poly1021 table at _DAT_080045c8, seed _DAT_080045c4 (=0xFFFF inferred), returns ~crc.
SRAM read wrapper: sets WAITCNT-ish *_DAT&mask|3, copies routine to stack, calls FUN_08054934 (SRAM-safe IWRAM/stack copy).
SRAM byte-copy write: *dest++=*src++ byte-wise (required for 8-bit SRAM bus) to 0x0E000000+offset; sets *_DAT|3 first.
SRAM verify/readback via FUN_08054934 stack routine; writer retries 5x on mismatch.

Save-all: loop slots0-5 FUN_08005098(i)+FUN_080024c8(i); if arg!=0 write6, CpuSet-prep, write7; write8 (cleared), FUN_08002748, write9, FUN_08026b04, write0 again, if arg FUN_08026acc+write7 again. No callers in callgraph (entry via unrecovered jumptable).
Prep slot9: zero buffer via FUN_08054774 (SWI 0x0B CpuSet), *(buf+2)=1.
Prep slots0-5 RAM buffer: loads ROM data (func_0x08054c04), zero via CpuSet, *(buf+3)=0x19, per-slot byte auStack_1c[i], copies data to buf+10.
Progression update + flush slot7 only: 5-group loop FUN_08003078/FUN_080235d0/FUN_08023594/FUN_080058d8 increments RAM counters, then FUN_080024c8(7).
Re-flush prep for slot7: zeroes *(DAT+4), loops 0x42=66 shorts calling FUN_080058d8(id,0); caller then re-writes slot7.
Increment RAM counter/flag struct indexed by id (cap 99, nested counters at +0x0C/+0x24, global +4); mutates slot7 RAM before flush.
Load-validity: FUN_08002610(6), FUN_08002610(7) -> 0 both ok, 1 one ok, 2 both fail.
FALSE SEED: SWI div/mod helper (signed remainder), not save I/O. Likewise FUN_08054b44 unsigned mod. Excluded.
